mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the so-called acceptable concentration standards promulgated by the American Standards Association (ASA)."
Closely related to TLVs are the so-called acceptable concentration standards promulgated by the American Standards Association (ASA).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the probability that injury may be caused by the circumstance of the exposure."
Hazard is the probability that injury may be caused by the circumstance of the exposure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the adverse effects of chemicals or physical agents on living organisms."
Toxicology is the study of the adverse effects of chemicals or physical agents on living organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systemic insecticide in that it is taken up by the roots and leaves of plants; insects that feed on the leaves are poisoned."
Highly water soluble carbofuran is a systemic insecticide in that it is taken up by the roots and leaves of plants; insects that feed on the leaves are poisoned.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unrestrained, malignant proliferation of somatic cell."
Cancer is the unrestrained, malignant proliferation of somatic cell.

Initiation may be defined as a stochastic process that involves one or more heritable alterations in DNA induced by diverse factors including mutagenic chemicals, ionising radiation and viruses.

Progression is the stage in which the neoplastic (cancerous) cells become a malignant tumour and may involve changes in the phenotype.

DDT is one of the most well known organochlorine pesticide and is also one of the oldest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the dose at which 10% of the individuals will die."
LDIO refers to the dose at which 10% of the individuals will die.
